name: recanime
description: RecAnime monorepo task runner (Go API + Swift apps). pnpm only orchestrates shell commands; there are no JS dependencies.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U recanime -d recanime
scripts.api:dev: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd services/api && go run ./cmd/api serve
scripts.api:fmt: cd services/api && gofmt -l -w . && go mod tidy
scripts.migrate: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd services/api && go run ./cmd/api migrate up
scripts.migrate:status: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd services/api && go run ./cmd/api migrate status
scripts.apple:gen: cd apple && xcodegen generate && mkdir -p RecAnime.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm && { [ -f RecAnime.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved ] || echo '{"pins":[],"version":3}' > RecAnime.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved; }
scripts.apple:build: pnpm apple:gen && xcodebuild -project apple/RecAnime.xcodeproj -scheme RecAnime -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.5' build
scripts.apple:test: pnpm apple:gen && xcodebuild -project apple/RecAnime.xcodeproj -scheme RecAnime -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.5' test -only-testing:RecAnimeTests
scripts.apple:test:all: pnpm apple:gen && xcodebuild -project apple/RecAnime.xcodeproj -scheme RecAnime -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.5' test
scripts.apple:watch:build: pnpm apple:gen && xcodebuild -project apple/RecAnime.xcodeproj -scheme RecAnimeWatch -destination 'platform=watchOS Simulator,name=Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm),OS=26.5' build
